evals.name: strategy-selection-undecided
evals.prompt: I have a Grasshopper model on ShapeDiver and I want to build a web configurator for my furniture product. I'm not sure which approach to use.
evals.expected_output: A clear explanation of the available integration strategies (App Builder, Viewer API, Headless) with guidance to help the user choose.
assertions: Presents at least three integration options: App Builder, Viewer 3 API, and Geometry SDK/Headless
Explains when to use each option (App Builder for ready-made UI, Viewer for custom control, Headless for backend)
Asks clarifying questions to determine the user's needs before recommending a specific path
Does NOT immediately start writing code without choosing a strategy first

evals.name: route-to-iframe
evals.prompt: I want to embed my ShapeDiver model on my WordPress site with minimal effort. No custom code needed.
evals.expected_output: Routes the user to the iframe/App Builder strategy and collects the model slug.
assertions: Recommends the iframe or App Builder approach (not Viewer API)
Asks for the model slug or App Builder URL
Does NOT ask for ticket or modelViewUrl (not needed for iframe embedding)
Mentions reading the shapediver-appbuilder or shapediver-appbuilder-iframe skill

evals.name: route-to-viewer-api
evals.prompt: I need to build a fully custom 3D configurator with drag-and-drop interactions, custom materials, and a completely custom React UI using my ShapeDiver model.
evals.expected_output: Routes the user to the Viewer 3 API path and collects the necessary credentials.
assertions: Recommends the Viewer 3 API approach (not App Builder)
Asks for ticket and modelViewUrl, or offers the API script as an alternative
Mentions reading the shapediver-viewer skill before writing code
Does NOT start writing Viewer API code without first collecting credentials
